# Jubilees Chapter 40 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 40:2 — "it was established" vs. "it was clear"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "it was established that there would be" | Formal; "established" has a legal/ordained sense |
| LOGOS | "it was established that there would be" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "seven years of extraordinary abundance" begins new sentence | Paraphrases without the "established" frame |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** EMET/LOGOS "it was established" adopted. The Ge'ez verb has the sense of "it was confirmed/decreed" — not merely "it was clear." PNEUMA drops this theological framing.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 40:9 — "spoke harshly" vs. "questioned harshly"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he spoke harshly to them and asked them" | Literal two-clause sequence |
| LOGOS | "He spoke harshly to them and questioned them" | Adds "questioned" for clarity |
| PNEUMA | "He grilled them" | Dynamic compression |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. Two distinct actions in Ge'ez: speaking harshly and then questioning. "Questioned" is more precise than "asked" for an interrogation. PNEUMA's "grilled" is vivid but too colloquial for formal register.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 40:12 — Jacob's grief speech

All three translators rendered this substantially the same. No significant disagreement.

**Status:** No disagreement.

---
